stock.description: As an investment holding company, Guru Online (Holdings) Limited specializes in delivering comprehensive digital marketing solutions across Hong Kong, Taiwan, and mainland China. The company's activities are organized into key divisions: Digital Advertisement Placement, Social Media Management, and Creative and Technology Services. Guru Online's diverse service portfolio includes executing advertisement campaigns across digital channels and expertly handling corporate social media profiles from initial setup to continuous monitoring. It also manages a specialized internet marketing platform tailored for the travel sector. Furthermore, the firm excels in designing and writing content for digital advertisements, developing corporate profile pages, websites, and mobile applications, and furnishing associated strategic consultancy. This provider of marketing services, established in 2007, maintains its principal office in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong.
